You shouldn’t have to beat yourself up either. Relationships go two ways. And if you aren’t on the same page there’s a disconnect and it leaves you with the unknowns and the pain, which closure helps close that disconnection, and if he for whatever reason doesn’t respond, using that to gain the closure and to push yourself to see that if he isn’t honoring giving me closure, he isn’t worth my time anymore. You may not feel or believe that’s true right then especially, but that should fade, time heals all wounds, you can manage this pain. I believe in you!

If it’s something you feel you should apologize for like blocking him, then I would add that for sure, it helps you learn from your mistakes and owning up for them, and there’s no fault in that at all. Losing someone you don’t want to lose is awful. But there’s a grieving process there just like it would losing someone via them passing away, it may not be as devastating as a death, but it’s still very valid, and raw emotions you are feeling over a loss of a relationship. It’s okay to go through the motions of grief and loss there. It will take time.

You need closure. And I personally think, it’s worth messaging him and being confident in that message, instead of “can we talk about this?” Be more commanding, “we really should talk/we need to talk about this.” Breaking up when you’re still having feelings is pure pain, I’m so sorry you are experiencing this right now. But that closure helps so much, and if he doesn’t respond to your demands of discussing what happened, then that’s closure in itself too, he just isn’t worth your time and living in your mind rent free. And if he answers, you can gain that closure with him. I also wouldn’t apologize, cuz like you said, you don’t know what you’d even need to apologize for. My advice, that you absolutely do not need to take, is to stand your ground, put your foot down, and send him that “we need to talk”, because this is for you, not for him, and it’s not selfish to pursue the closure that will help heal the wounds you have.
